articles.body: A Palestinian man inspects the damage at a mosque, which Palestinians say was damaged by Israeli settlers, in Qusra near Nablus, in the Israeli-occupied West Bank, July 26, 2026.... Purchase Licensing Rights , opens new tab Read more Summary Palestinians say villagers were defending against settlers trying to drive them off land Netanyahu's government characterized the incident as terrorism Reuters saw cut tree trunks after residents said settlers felled olive and fig trees Settlement expansion has accelerated before October elections as ministers push tighter West Bank control TAL, West Bank, July 27 (Reuters) - Palestinian villagers in the occupied West Bank said on Monday the area was coming close to breaking point after increasing ​incursions by Israeli settlers and violent stand-offs, such as one that left six people shot dead last week. The Israeli military made dozens of arrests and blocked roadways through the West Bank ‌after Friday's incident in the village of Tal, southwest of Nablus, where four Palestinians and two Israelis were killed. The Reuters Iran Briefing newsletter keeps you informed with the latest developments and analysis of the Iran war. Sign up here. Early on Monday, most entrances to Tal, neighbouring villages and Nablus were either partially or fully shuttered, creating long lines of residents seeking to pass the checkpoints. 'IF THEY COME, WE'LL MEET THEM' Friday's shootings occurred after villagers from Tal confronted a large group of armed settlers they said tried to enter houses in the village. The Israeli military said there was a "violent confrontation" between dozens of Palestinians ​and Israeli civilians in which shots were fired on both sides. Prime Minister Netanyahu's government has characterized the incident as terrorism but Palestinians say villagers were defending themselves against the latest in a ​series of attacks by settlers seeking to drive them off the land. Ahmed Ramadan, 71, the father of one of the Palestinians killed on Friday, said settlers have ⁠continually harassed their home on the edge of Tal overlooking the rolling hills of the West Bank. "They say we are terrorists. We are not terrorists," said Ramadan. He said the settler killed on Friday, Benayahu ​Mellet — an army reservist who was serving as security coordinator for the nearby settlement of Havat Gilad — had previously come to his home and yelled at him to leave and go to Syria or Jordan. Ramadan said he ​had no intention of leaving, "Even if we die, we'll die here on our land. We're not prepared to leave this country." Sitting at home with his surviving sons, he said if settlers return in force the village was ready. "If they come, we'll meet them head-on, even if they kill us," he told Reuters. SHUTDOWN Israeli authorities initially portrayed Friday's incident as an attack by Palestinians on hikers walking near the village, located in Area A of the West Bank, a zone under Palestinian control that ​Israelis are generally prohibited from entering. Video widely circulated on social media showed settlers carrying rifles and pushing residents as they approached the village. Reuters was not able to independently verify the video. Palestinians from Tal said settlers ​attacked them first before one of the villagers wrestled a gun from one of the settlers. The incident followed a pattern seen repeatedly around the West Bank, with large groups of settlers appearing near Palestinian communities, threatening and harassing their ‌inhabitants, often as security ⁠forces stand by . Such shows of force have become more frequent over recent months, while ministers in Netanyahu's government talk openly about annexing the West Bank, which Israel occupied following the 1967 Middle East war. On Monday, Reuters reporters could see freshly cut tree trunks in fields at the edge of the village. Residents said that after the violence on Friday, settlers had come and cut down olive and fig trees. According to United Nations figures, 18 Palestinians have been killed in incidents linked to settler attacks so far this year, compared with 17 in the whole of 2025. The Palestinian Authority says at least 20 Palestinians have been killed by settlers since ​the start of the year. Since Friday, residents said ​there have been daily military raids on Tal, ⁠with between 60 and 80 people detained. About 30 remain in detention according to the deputy head of the village council Munther Shtayya. In the early hours of Monday, residents said the military threw a man out of his house on the edge of the village. Reuters observed two soldiers standing on the roof of the man's home. "All ​of the military is here in the streets," Kamal Shtayya, 55, a resident of Tal, said. 'THERE MUST BE AN EXPLOSION' As Netanyahu's government approaches elections in ​October, it has stepped up ⁠authorization for new settlement building in a drive ministers say is intended to tighten Israeli control over the West Bank. The United Nations, Palestinians and most countries regard settlements as illegal under international law. Israel disputes this, saying the West Bank, which it captured in the 1967 war, is disputed territory, and citing biblical ties to the land. "I'm patient, we'll be patient and patient and patient, but at the end of the day, patience runs out. It just ⁠flies away, it ​doesn't work," 72-year-old Tal farmer Ahmed Shtayya said. "Any human being defends himself," he told Reuters. Like many Palestinian farmers, Shtayya, who grows ​tomatoes, figs and eggplants, has seen settlers come ever closer. He said settlers have come up to him as he has been working, telling him the land was Israeli. Just a few hundred metres up the road lies a burned-out home attacked by settlers a ​week ago, according to the vice head of the village council. "I've come to this point. If they want to continue like this, there must be an explosion, what else?" Shtayya said. articles.body: Item 5 of 5 Supporters of India's Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) move past a CCTV camera at the ongoing protest site, days after thousands of protesters marched towards parliament demanding the resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan over National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) examination paper leaks, at Jantar Mantar in New Delhi, July 24, 2026. REUTERS/Bhawika Chhabra [5/5] Supporters of India's Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) move past a CCTV camera at the ongoing protest site, days after thousands of protesters marched towards parliament demanding the resignation of... Purchase Licensing Rights , opens new tab Read more Summary Court examining lawsuit on surveillance measures at protest Police used facial recognition van, collected Instagram handles India has no law governing police use of facial recognition NEW DELHI, July 27 (Reuters) - Indian activists are challenging Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government over the use of AI-powered surveillance at the largest youth protest in decades, ​with one court case set to become a test of federal powers even after agitation ended. The surveillance controversy erupted during last week's ‌student protests over exam paper leaks, when demonstrators posted pictures on social media of a mobile police surveillance van equipped with cameras on a telescopic mast providing a 360-degree view of the gathering. Get the latest news from India and how it matters to the world with the Reuters India File newsletter. Sign up here. One protester, student activist Aishe Ghosh, has asked the Delhi High Court to declare mass surveillance of protesters unconstitutional and direct the destruction of all personal data collected during the ​protest, as well as order the framing of guidelines on how surveillance technology can be used. Ghosh is pressing on with the case even though ​the protest ended after Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned in a rare setback for Modi, who has since announced a panel ⁠to overhaul the cheating-prone exam system . India has no law governing the use of facial recognition technology by police and surveillance at the main protest site in New Delhi ​was a breach of the law, activists say. The government says such checks were legal and in the public interest to ensure law and order. Modi's government has often been ​accused by opposition parties and digital rights advocates of expanding surveillance powers and tightly controlling digital communications. It has rejected such accusations, saying it only acts in the public interest. During a hearing on Friday, Solicitor General Tushar Mehta defended the Indian police conduct, saying privacy claims at a public gathering were "ironical" and the checks were "absolutely necessary" and "in legitimate state interest." In a brief ​hearing on Monday, judges heard arguments from Ghosh that intrusive mass surveillance of protesters was disproportionate, as she sought broader disclosures on the state's surveillance policies ​during protests. The court will hear the matter on Tuesday. 'NEED FOR ACCOUNTABILITY' Internet Freedom Foundation, a New Delhi-based digital advocacy group, wrote to Delhi's police commissioner on July 24 demanding the ‌deletion of ⁠biometric data collected at the protest site. Delhi police did not respond to a Reuters request for comment. In a post on social media platform X on Sunday, the force said it had not "restricted anyone's freedom through the use of facial recognition technology". "We need proportionality even if we are to claim national security risks. Accountability must flow both ways," said Akash Karmakar, a technology law partner at Indian law firm Panag & Babu. He said if India used facial recognition to track protesters, it must ​also be used to identify police ​officers who allegedly acted without name ⁠badges during the crackdown. Police were also seen noting Instagram handles of protesters arriving at the site. When asked why, Inspector Sunil Kumar told Reuters the checks were to ensure no-one with a criminal background entered the protest. 'FACE ACCURACY' MATCH The surveillance van ​parked at the site was emblazoned with the Delhi Police crest and the branding "Ikshana", Hindi for "vision". There is little detail ​online about Ikshana, barring ⁠one post from its development partner, Indian CCTV company CP Plus, which said they were equipped with "Advanced AI-powered" cameras, mobile cameras and "Varifocal Bullet Cameras" with adjustable lenses. The 2023 post on CP Plus' website was removed over the weekend and was no longer accessible. CP Plus did not respond to a request for comment. When a Reuters reporter walked ⁠past the ​van last week, one computer display inside showed his face with a green rectangular box around ​it and a "face accuracy" match metric next to it. Soon after, a police officer inside shut the van's window. "The computers here help us identify those who have a criminal history and it highlights them," ​police officer Raj Kumar Dahiya told Reuters. "AI also helps us count the number of protesters". Reporting by Saurabh Sharma, Munsif Vengattil; Editing by Aditya Kalra and Alex Richardson Our Standards: The Thomson Reuters Trust Principles. , opens new tab Suggested Topics: Artificial Intelligence Human Rights X Facebook Linkedin Email Link Purchase Licensing Rights Munsif Vengattil Thomson Reuters Based in Bengaluru, Munsif Vengattil leads Reuters' technology news coverage in India. He tracks themes at the intersection of tech, business, and labor. A reporter for nine years, Munsif has written extensively on India's electronics manufacturing aspirations and its tech policy space, AI and election interference, satellite internet, streaming wars, and data breaches. His stories also focus on investigating corporate strategies and revealing India-specific initiatives and challenges of the biggest of tech firms - from Apple, Facebook, and Google, to Foxconn, Samsung, and Nvidia. articles.body: Item 3 of 3 German Chancellor Friedrich Merz gives a statement after a deadly incident in which a vehicle crashed into a crowd near Berlin's annual Christopher Street Day Pride parade on Saturday evening, leaving multiple people injured and the parade called off, in Berlin, Germany, July 26, 2026. REUTERS/Christian Mang [3/3] German Chancellor Friedrich Merz gives a statement after a deadly incident in which a vehicle crashed into a crowd near Berlin's annual Christopher Street Day Pride parade on Saturday evening,... Purchase Licensing Rights , opens new tab Read more Summary Merz tasks interior minister with examining jurisdiction changes Prosecutors said suspect received ​prison sentence under juvenile law in May Federal prosecutors released a second suspect detained over ‌the attack BERLIN, July 27 (Reuters) - Chancellor Friedrich Merz on Monday vowed to take action in response to the vehicle ramming attack on the Berlin Pride celebration as debate erupted in Germany over why the suspected driver was not ​in prison. The suspect, who was shot dead by police on Sunday, was identified as 21-year-old ​German citizen Abdul Ballout, who was recently convicted of preparing a violent act ⁠and was believed to have tried to join the Islamic State militant group. Get a look at the day ahead in European and global markets with the Morning Bid Europe newsletter. Sign up here. "It is still ​too early to say what political conclusions we will draw from this brutal attack. ... We will have ​to respond with prudence, but also with determination," Merz said at a party press conference. One person died in the attack in the Tiergarten park near the Brandenburg Gate on Saturday evening, whom Poland's foreign minister identified as a ​Polish woman aged about 60. Bild newspaper said the victim was visiting the Christopher Street Day celebrations with her ​daughter, who herself suffered injuries. Suspected attacker Ballout was a German citizen with Lebanese roots and born and raised in Berlin, ‌according ⁠to Germany's interior minister. Police said they opened fire on him on Sunday when he ran towards officers armed with a bladed weapon. In May, Ballout was convicted of preparing a serious act of violence endangering the state and was sentenced under juvenile law to one year and 10 months in ​prison, according to prosecutors. He was ​released under the ⁠supervision of a probation officer for six months after the court deferred a decision on whether to suspend the sentence. Prosecutors had appealed the ruling, ​seeking a longer sentence. Merz said police surveillance of convicted criminals was regional states' responsibility ​but added ⁠he had tasked the federal interior minister with looking into changing jurisdiction. The German leader also questioned how the suspect was able to approach the event despite supposedly being under constant surveillance. A second suspect detained ⁠in connection ​with the attack has been released, the German federal prosecutors' ​office said on Monday. Spiegel magazine cited sources as saying that authorities released the person because initial suspicion that he was ​a passenger in the ramming vehicle attack could not be confirmed. articles.body: ABUJA, July 27 (Reuters) - At least 30 people were killed when armed men attacked a village in Nigeria's ​northwestern Kaduna state early on Monday, two ‌residents said. Dogon Rana, secretary to the village head, said gunmen stormed the community shooting randomly and burning houses. Eight ​children were among the dead, while four ​other people sustained injuries. The Reuters Daily Briefing newsletter provides all the news you need to start your day. Sign up here. Violence by armed gangs and ⁠other criminal groups has become a major ​security challenge across parts of northwestern and north-central Nigeria, ​where communities are frequently targeted in deadly raids. The northeast is battling a deadly insurgency by Islamist militants Boko Haram and ​splinter group ISWAP. No group has claimed ​responsibility for the attack in Kaduna state. Youth leader Ishaya Dawa, another ‌resident, ⁠said the attackers stormed Naridon village in Kauru local government area close to midnight and opened fire on residents. Dawa said some residents were slaughtered, ​adding that several ​bodies had ⁠been taken to the mortuary. "The victims are women, children and the elderly," ​Dawa said. The assailants set houses on ​fire ⁠before fleeing, he said. Dawa said security personnel arrived at the village in the morning, hours after the ⁠attack. Kaduna ​State police spokesperson Mansur Hassan ​said the command would provide details soon. The ​man attacked the three women, who were aged ⁠19, 24 and 36, with two kitchen knives, severely wounding ​two of them, Nunez said. The Reuters Daily Briefing newsletter provides all the news you need to start your day. Sign up here. Video aired on social platform X and ​verified by Reuters showed a man with long black hair, wearing a cream tracksuit and wielding one big knife in each hand stabbing and attempting ​to attack a young woman. It is unclear if ​the woman was injured. Another part of the video shows the same ‌man ⁠lying on the ground immobilized by bystanders, while the two knives are lying nearby on a pedestrian crossing. "It is Allah who commanded me," the man lying on the floor ​said. Nunez said the ​man had ⁠been detained by an off-duty police officer. "I pay tribute to him, it was a courageous ​act," he added. The motive of the attack ​remains unknown, ⁠Nunez said, adding police could not verify the identity of the attacker, whose declarations were "incoherent" while he was being arrested. The French national ⁠anti-terrorist ​prosecutor's office said it was weighing ​whether to open an investigation. articles.body: Item 2 of 2 A woman walks near a billboard depicting U.S. President Donald Trump on a building in Tehran, Iran, July 27, 2026. Majid Asgaripour/WANA (West Asia News Agency) via REUTERS [2/2] A woman walks near a billboard depicting U.S. President Donald Trump on a building in Tehran, Iran, July 27, 2026. Majid Asgaripour/WANA (West Asia News Agency) via REUTERS Purchase Licensing Rights , opens new tab Summary U.S. official says military commanders advised Trump they were running out of targets Two-week bombing campaign killed scores in Iran; four US service members died Iran state media: six ships turned back in strait trying to pass without Tehran's permission DUBAI, July 27 (Reuters) - Iran said on Monday it was still in control of the Strait of Hormuz and not seeking to resume peace talks with ​the United States, after President Donald Trump halted a two-week bombing campaign that his top brass told him had run its course. Following 13 successive nights of intensifying bombing that ‌provoked Tehran to fire on U.S. bases in response, Trump halted the campaign over the weekend. Iran said it would pause its own attacks for as long as the U.S. pause in bombing endures. The Reuters Iran Briefing newsletter keeps you informed with the latest developments and analysis of the Iran war. Sign up here. Trump's decision to suspend the campaign reflected advice from his top brass that the bombing, aimed at breaking Iran's grip on strait , had reached the limits of what it could achieve, according to a U.S. official and widespread U.S. media reports. The U.S. official told Reuters that military commanders had ​advised the president that they were running out of targets. The official said the chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, General Dan Caine, had also expressed concern over the depletion ​of air defence weapons used to protect U.S. bases in the region. Similar reports indicating that civilian and military aides had advised Trump to halt the ⁠campaign were carried over the weekend by the New York Times, CNN, Axios and other news outlets. The U.S. ambassador to the United Nations, Mike Waltz, said on Sunday Trump had paused the campaign to ​allow room for negotiations. But the spokesperson for Iran's Foreign Ministry, Esmail Baghaei, said in a televised press conference on Monday that Iran had not asked to resume peace talks with the United States. The end of ​the U.S. bombing campaign sent oil prices tumbling in the hope that disrupted global supplies could resume flowing. Brent crude, which had briefly ticked above $100 a barrel last week for the first time since May, fell around 7.8% by mid-morning on Monday to just under $90. But in a clear bid to signal that the U.S. bombing had failed in its objective, Tehran indicated it was still in control of the world's most important waterway for energy markets. IRAN STATE MEDIA SAY SIX SHIPS ​TURNED BACK IN STRAIT Several Iranian state media outlets carried the same report, citing an "informed source" as saying that Iran had turned around six "offending ships" on Monday morning that had attempted to cross the strait ​without its permission. One of the vessels, the source said, had had "an accident". "As previously announced, the traffic route in the Strait of Hormuz is the route specified by Iran, and other routes are contaminated and have no way ‌out," the ⁠Iranian state media reports quoted the source as saying. Trump launched his renewed bombing campaign to punish Iran after Tehran fired on ships using a route through the strait that has been promoted by the United States, which has told vessels to sail close to the coast of Oman. Iran says ships may pass only through a channel that runs closer to its own coast, which it controls and where it intends to impose transit fees. The two weeks of renewed U.S. bombing killed scores of people in Iran and destroyed bridges and tunnels across the south as well as military targets. Four U.S. service members were killed by ​Iran's return fire against U.S. bases in neighbouring ​Arab states. Iran also struck civilian infrastructure in ⁠Gulf countries in what it said was retaliation for U.S. strikes on civilian targets. Last week Iran's Houthi allies threatened to extend the disruption to global oil supplies to a second major waterway by announcing a blockade of Saudi Arabia's oil industry in the Red Sea, sending oil prices even higher. The halt to ​the renewed U.S. bombing campaign leaves no clear indication of what leverage Washington can exert to achieve Trump's aim to break Iran's grip on ​the strait. Washington and Tehran reached ⁠an agreement in June on a framework for talks meant to take place by the end of August to resolve major issues such as Iran's nuclear programme. But the sides have disputed the meaning of the memorandum's language about the Strait of Hormuz , with Washington insisting it requires Tehran to allow free travel while Iran says it grants it the authority to supervise transit. Iran aims to formalise its control over the strait by reaching an agreement ⁠with Oman, which ​controls the opposite shore. A senior Omani delegation was in Tehran over the weekend discussing the future of the strait. The ​foreign ministers of Qatar, the United Arab Emirates and Saudi Arabia each had held phone calls to discuss the strait with Oman's Foreign Minister Badr Albusaidi, according to reports on Monday on Qatari, UAE and Saudi state media. Israel's Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who ​launched the war in February alongside Trump but has not participated in the U.S.-Iranian negotiations to end it, is due to meet Trump in Washington early this week. REUTERS/Stringer/File Photo [2/2] Myanmar military personnel participate in a parade commemorating the 81st Armed Forces Day in Naypyidaw, Myanmar, March 27, 2026. REUTERS/Stringer/File Photo Purchase Licensing Rights , opens new tab Summary Surge in violence linked to new military chief's tactics — ACLED Conflict monitor records more than a dozen mass killings in 2026, over 450 civilians dead Former junta chief turned president Min Aung ​Hlaing to visit Thailand on August 6 to 7 July 27 (Reuters) - Myanmar's military has sharply escalated attacks on civilians since a ‌new administration took office in the war-torn country, a conflict monitor said on Monday, even as regional governments ramp up diplomatic engagement. The Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project (ACLED) said the onslaught was a result of the tactics deployed by Myanmar's new military chief who took over in late March as his ​predecessor prepared to become the country's president. Make sense of global markets with the Trading Day newsletter. Sign up here. "Since the ruling junta in Myanmar reconfigured its military command structure in March, ​civilians have been subject to the military's worsening repression and intensified aerial bombing campaign," ACLED said. "These adjustments ⁠included the regular deployment of specialised groups of two to five jet fighters executing sustained airstrikes against single targets." A Myanmar government ​spokesperson did not immediately respond to questions from Reuters. ACLED gathers data on Myanmar's ongoing conflict from media reports and local partners, as ​well as reports by the UN, international monitoring groups and local human rights organisations. Myanmar was plunged into turmoil after the military ousted Aung San Suu Kyi 's elected government in February 2021, sparking a civil war that has killed some 100,000 people and displaced millions. Days before becoming president after an election that banned most opposition, ​Min Aung Hlaing appointed long-time loyalist and former spymaster Ye Win Oo as the military's new commander-in-chief. Under his command, the military has launched renewed ​offensives into several border regions, including a frontier area with critical rare earth deposits and other vital trade routes. "Reprieve for civilians is unlikely as ‌the junta ⁠focuses its efforts on consolidating control following coup leader Min Aung Hlaing's transition from commander of the military to civilian president in April," ACLED said. MASS KILLINGS During the first half of 2026, ACLED said it recorded more than a dozen mass killings, resulting in over 450 civilian fatalities, around 40% of them in Myanmar's central dry zone known as the Anyar region. In May, hundreds of junta troops ​swept through parts of Myit ​Chay township, across the river ⁠from the ancient temples of Bagan, killing at least 40 people, three residents of the area told Reuters. "About 700 soldiers came into the town, grabbed the belongings of the people here and then ​beat them and killed them," said Ye Naung, 35. Reuters could not independently verify accounts of the ​incident at Myit ⁠Chay, which is part of ACLED's event database with at least five fatalities and was reported by local media. "The military's tactics in 2026 so far show merely shifting modalities of civilian repression rather than any reduction in its severity," ACLED said. The political transition in Myanmar has triggered ⁠a flurry ​of diplomacy, with Min Aung Hlaing travelling to key neighbours India and China . There has also ​been tentative re-engagement with the 11-member Association of Southeast Asian Nations bloc, which barred Myanmar's ruling generals from its summits after the coup. articles.body: Michigan Democratic Senate candidates Rep. Haley Stevens and Abdul El-Sayed agreed on one thing during Monday’s primary debate: Stevens is not an ogre. But Stevens used El-Sayed’s recent musings to donors about the national stakes of his victory to slam the progressive as being too focused on politics beyond Michigan. “He said that he's not going to be able to get much done. That he's not focused on policy for the first two years that he is in the United States Senate. That he's going to be focused on national politics,” Stevens said during the debate. “Michigan needs a workhorse.” El-Sayed had told donors on a Zoom call that, if he were elected, he would back a primary challenge to Democratic Pennsylvania Sen. John Fetterman in 2028: “Ideally you put one ogre on a pike, and then everyone else gets the message,” he said, according to audio obtained and published by POLITICO on Monday. The recording offered the candidates a fresh opportunity to trade attacks in what has been a bitter and ferocious primary, marked by accusations of racism and sexism and battles over Israel’s influence and outside spending. Some Democrats were quick to assume El-Sayed’s “ogre” comment was in reference to Stevens, and criticized his word choice. In Monday’s debate, the final public face-off between the two candidates before the Aug. 4 primary, Fox 2 Detroit moderator Roop Raj asked El-Sayed if he regretted the remark. “I was referring to a guy named John Fetterman, who's a senator from Pennsylvania, who has done terrible things, got elected on a set of values, and is now completely throwing those values in the mud,” El-Sayed said. He also attempted to redirect questions about the audio by implicating Stevens in the race’s heightened rhetoric, blaming her for AIPAC-funded ads portraying him as chauvinistic. Still, Stevens used the exchange to attack him for having higher political ambitions that could distract him from addressing the concerns of Michigan voters. Later in the debate, Stevens suggested El-Sayed is eyeing a future presidential run. She did offer him a tongue-in-cheek olive branch, though. “Thank you for clarifying that you didn't call me an ogre,” she said.
articles.headline: Stevens to El-Sayed: ‘Thank you for clarifying that you didn’t call me an ogre’

articles.body: Michigan Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed is facing backlash from within his own party after using controversial rhetoric to describe the stakes of his victory in a recent donor meeting. "If I win ... well y'all came at me so now I get to come at you, and you know, primarying people like John Fetterman, I have no problem to do that," he said, according to audio of a Zoom meeting obtained by POLITICO. "Ideally you put one ogre on a pike, and then everyone else gets the message, and all of a sudden starts to sound a lot different," El-Sayed added later, referencing how he could help propel the progressive moment. On Monday, several Democrats were quick to slam his comments. "Violent, vulgar threats have no place in a democratic electoral contest," said Rep. Hillary Scholten (D-Mich.). "With political violence on the rise, we need to be doing everything we can to lower the temperature — not raise it. It's the American people who suffer most when we degrade the political process this way." Some took El-Sayed's remarks as an attack on the party. Shannon Watts, founder of gun violence prevention group Moms Demand Action, said on X that El-Sayed "doesn’t mean Republicans." Another gun control activist, Fred Guttenberg, wrote : "That is what Abdul El-Sayed and his DSA movement think of Democrats and the party." Guttenberg — whose daughter was killed in the Parkland, Florida, school shooting — urged Michiganders to support El-Sayed's primary opponent, Rep. Haley Stevens, and "show AES the loss he deserves." An El-Sayed campaign spokesperson referred POLITICO back to an earlier statement that the candidate was “speaking metaphorically” about his intention to support a primary against Fetterman, a Pennsylvania senator. Fetterman and El-Sayed have clashed over support for Israel. The senator, who possesses a towering stature, has been mocked for his physical appearance by political rivals, and the "ogre" moniker partly stems from an attack by Kari Lake , a failed Republican Arizona gubernatorial candidate and ally of President Donald Trump. "I pick being Senator Shrek over being the Pontiac Platner any day," Fetterman said in a statement, referencing former Senate Maine Democratic nominee Graham Platner , who ended his campaign following a sexual assault allegation against him . El-Sayed’s leaked comments and the reaction to them amount to another flashpoint in a tense primary that is dividing the progressive and moderate wings of the party, and at times has been defined by accusations of racism and sexism. A few Democrats assumed the candidate's comments were a reference to Stevens, though El-Sayed had not explicitly mentioned his opponent in the portion of the call POLITICO reviewed. “Calling your female opponent an ogre you want to put on a pike is not beating the rap that this race has some serious sexism,” Neera Tanden, a centrist Democrat and president of the Center for American Progress, posted on X. Melissa Byrne, a former staffer for Sen. Bernie Sanders (I-Vt.), called the remark an “unforced error” that is “really bad and beneath the progressive project.” She later deleted the post. "Abdul continues with personal insults and making this race about his personal political ambitions and the other 49 states,” said Arik Wolk, spokesperson for the Stevens campaign. “Haley is focused on getting things done for Michigan, and only Michigan." Republicans, too, jumped on the comment, with some leaning into stereotypes of El-Sayed’s religion as a Muslim. “Michigan Islamist discusses beheading his opponents,” said Steve Guest, a former staffer for Sen. Ted Cruz, on X.  This is not the first time El-Sayed has used — and defended — aggressive political rhetoric. "When they go low, we don’t go high," the progressive said while speaking at a campaign rally earlier this year, riffing on a famous line from former first lady Michelle Obama. "We take them to the mud and choke them out." He and Stevens will face off in their final Democratic Senate debate Monday night, and the results of the Aug. 4 primary could have major consequences for the party as it grapples with its ideological tack ahead of the 2028 presidential election.
articles.headline: El-Sayed comes under fire for 'ogre on a pike' leaked comment

articles.body: BANGOR, Maine — Republicans had months to research and rebuke Graham Platner. They now have exactly 100 days to sink his replacement. Troy Jackson is like Platner but worse. He’s a socialist who’s flip-flopped on policy, a career politician who keeps losing, an insider who is also unknown. His nomination was illegitimate, he has anger issues, and he lacks “rizz.” That’s just a sampling of the messaging the GOP plans to use to trounce Jackson, the former Maine Senate president who lost this year’s Democratic gubernatorial primary only to glide this weekend into the party’s nomination to challenge Sen. Susan Collins (R-Maine) in November. “Mainers already rejected Troy Jackson once this year after his failed campaign for governor. Now Democrats are asking voters to believe the politician they didn’t want leading Augusta belongs in the United States Senate,” the NRSC, Senate Republicans’ campaign arm, wrote in a “messaging guidance” document about Jackson, viewed by Playbook. “Jackson is a radical, ill-tempered career politician whose failed record and socialist agenda make him unfit to represent Maine.” The stakes are high. Collins is the only Republican senator running for re-election this cycle in a state Kamala Harris won in 2024, and Democrats’ hopes of retaking the chamber track straight through Maine — a reality the NRSC admitted is possible in its new donor memo , shared first with Playbook, acknowledging that “Jackson is fully capable of winning this seat if we become complacent.” Republicans’ first plan of attack is to link Jackson to Platner, with whom he campaigned and shares much of his populist platform. As soon as Jackson’s nomination became official yesterday, the Senate Leadership Fund, the Senate GOP’s super PAC, announced that it was launching a six-figure ad blitz that begins by depicting the two Democrats hugging on stage. “Jackson is like Graham Platner but worse,” the ad says, citing reporting from WaPo , CNN and other outlets about Jackson’s alleged sharp temper and heated interactions with colleagues. The NRSC yesterday posted a video on X depicting Platner literally transforming into Jackson — with the caption “No tattoo, same crazy,” a reference to Platner’s tattoo that resembled a Nazi symbol. “Troy Jackson is all the baggage without the ‘rizz,” James Blair, who leads President Donald Trump’s outside political operation, said on X . Jackson campaigned alongside Platner and stood by him through several scandals — until POLITICO reported earlier this month that a woman who dated Platner said he had sexually assaulted her, a claim Platner denies. In response, Jackson publicly disavowed Platner and said he had “lied to me.” Jackson told reporters yesterday he has not spoken to Platner since then. Asked to respond to SLF’s ad, Jackson said “anyone that I may have argued with, that I might have went too far or got too passionate, I apologize to.” The GOP’s second push is to brand Jackson as a “political insider” — a bid to undermine his populist bonafides at a time when voters from neither party trust establishment politicians. “We must act immediately to define him before national Democrats frame him as a populist outsider,” the NRSC memo said. “Chuck Schumer forcefully removed Graham Platner from the ballot against the will of Maine voters, only to replace him with a deranged and scandal-plagued political insider,” SLF Communications Director Chris Gustafson said in a statement to POLITICO. Part of that strategy is to not only label Jackson as a longserving member of the establishment (Collins, for what it’s worth, has held her seat for nearly three decades), but as a political insider who has failed when seeking higher office. As state Senate president, Jackson was the second-highest ranking official in Maine — but he ran unsuccessfully for the Democratic nomination for Congress in 2014 and for governor earlier this year, a fresh wound Republicans are eager to pick at. Compounding that insider image is the way Maine Democrats selected Jackson: While more than 200,000 Mainers voted for Platner in the primary, just 566 Democratic delegates actively chose Jackson at yesterday’s nominating convention — a fact Republicans hope to spin into a narrative that Jackson was coronated by party insiders. “Not one single vote was cast for Troy Jackson” in the Senate race, RNC Chair Joe Gruters said on X . “Just one month ago, Troy came in third in the Democratic primary for Governor. Now he will run for Senate as the third choice of his party insiders,” Collins campaign spokesperson Shawn Roderick said in a statement to Playbook. He added, “in a process concocted by the Maine Democratic Party establishment, a 24-year Augusta insider was appointed to run for the Senate by fewer than three-tenths of one percent of its primary voters.” Jackson, for his part, appears committed to maintaining his image as a populist who, as has become his campaign motto, comes neither from the left nor the right, but “from the bottom.” He’s more eager to bring up being a fifth-generation logger than his decades of experience in state politics — and at any mention of his relationship to Platner, he’s quick to pivot to his role as part of a broader pro-worker movement. And his campaign is staying laser-focused on attacking Collins . “Only Susan Collins could spend nearly 30 years in Washington voting with Donald Trump 96 percent of the time and taking millions from corporate special interests, then call a fifth-generation logger from Allagash a ‘party insider,’” Jackson campaign adviser BJ McCollister said in a statement to Playbook. “Mainers know who Troy Jackson is—and they know exactly who Susan Collins works for.” Asked yesterday to respond to the GOP messaging shortly after clinching the official nomination, Jackson told reporters that he attributes Republicans’ attacks to “Senator Collins trying to make sure that she can win re-election on a really bad record.” “I've been in the legislature for 20 years,” he added. “I do believe I've been vetted. I've been tested. People know exactly what I'm fighting for. They know that I've had their back, and they know they can trust me.” Andrew Howard contributed to this report.

articles.body: <p>El incendio que amenaza con devorar el pulmón verde de Castellón avanza sin freno. El fuego, que se originó el sábado por la mañana en un barrio de La Vall d’Uixó, junto a la montaña, <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/comunidad-valenciana/2026-07-27/12-municipios-evacuados-por-el-incendio-de-la-vall-duixo-integran-el-parque-natural-de-sierra-de-espadan-el-pulmon-verde-de-castellon.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/comunidad-valenciana/2026-07-27/12-municipios-evacuados-por-el-incendio-de-la-vall-duixo-integran-el-parque-natural-de-sierra-de-espadan-el-pulmon-verde-de-castellon.html">sigue ganando terreno y ya ha arrasado 8.500 hectáreas</a>, la mayor parte de ellas en el parque natural de la Sierra de Espadán. Hasta el Puesto de Mando Avanzado de la Vall d’Uixó se ha desplazado este lunes el presidente del Gobierno, Pedro Sánchez, quien, tras reunirse con los responsables del dispositivo, ha advertido de que “quedan horas difíciles y complejas”. La preocupación, ha señalado, aumenta ante la inminente llegada de una nueva ola de calor, que traerá un nuevo ascenso de las temperaturas y complicará aún más el trabajo de los equipos desplegados sobre el terreno. Ante ese escenario, Sánchez ha apelado a la ciudadanía para que extreme la prevención.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-07-27/sanchez-advierte-de-que-el-incendio-de-la-vall-duixo-afronta-horas-dificiles-y-complejas.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p><img src="https://imagenes.elpais.com/resizer/v2/66VLITLACBANPOUAQQVK2GEW44.jpg?auth=d0b223eb72465f8112b63a397448b35b293d6a4e5781cc164d4067d02542c360" width="3543" height="2362" alt="La Brigada de Refuerzo de Incendios Forestales de Daroca (Aragón) que intervienen en la extinción del incendio forestal de la Vall d'Uixó."></img>

articles.body: <p>No existe una<i> ley de nietos</i>. Es una verdad incuestionable en medio de la catarata de acusaciones emitidas por el líder del PP, Alberto Núñez Feijóo, sobre la instrucción referida a las nacionalizaciones de los nietos de los exiliados por la dictadura que desarrolla un apartado de la ley de Memoria Democrática. Pero esa mal llamada <i>ley de nietos</i> no es ilegal, <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-07-13/la-ley-de-nietos-que-cuestiona-el-pp-paso-32-tramites-parlamentarios-en-cinco-anos.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-07-13/la-ley-de-nietos-que-cuestiona-el-pp-paso-32-tramites-parlamentarios-en-cinco-anos.html">porque está en vigor, aprobada por las Cortes tras 32 pasos parlamentarios</a> y publicada en e<i>l Boletín Oficial del Estado</i> (BOE) desde 2022, ni es recurrible ya en plazo,<a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-07-16/la-junta-electoral-rechaza-quitar-el-voto-por-correo-a-los-residentes-en-el-extranjero-pero-pide-aclaraciones-al-ine-sobre-los-empadronamientos.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-07-16/la-junta-electoral-rechaza-quitar-el-voto-por-correo-a-los-residentes-en-el-extranjero-pero-pide-aclaraciones-al-ine-sobre-los-empadronamientos.html"> ni la Junta Electoral Central (JEC) la ha cuestionado, al rechazar las impugnaciones planteadas por uno de sus componentes por nueve votos frente a cuatro.</a> Esa polémica instrucción que ahora focaliza los ataques del PP ha permitido ampliar los beneficios de las nacionalizaciones a muchas más personas que las exiliadas por la dictadura, como pedían los populares gallegos históricamente y Feijóo metió en su programa electoral para las generales de 2023.El presidente del PP utilizó una gran parte de su última comparecencia de balance del curso político, el pasado miércoles, para volver a arremeter contra esa instrucción de <a href="https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2022-17099" rel="" title="https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2022-17099">la Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública del Ministerio de Justicia que se publicó en el BOE el 26 de octubre de 2022</a> con el objetivo de aclarar posibles dudas de los encargados de las Oficinas del Registro Civil sobre los beneficiados de las nacionalizaciones extraordinarias que prometió la ley de Memoria Democrática de 2021. Feijóo acusó a esa instrucción de estar “manipulada” para nacionalizar a “nietos, bisnietos y tataranietos” y la tildó de “ilegal de pleno derecho” basándose en el contenido de un voto particular de un representante nominado por el PP en la JEC que fue derrotado por nueve votos frente a cuatro. El alcance de la ley y la instrucción solo llega, para empezar, a los nietos de esos exiliados.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-07-27/la-ley-de-nietos-ni-fue-recurrida-ni-la-junta-electoral-la-cuestiona.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>
articles.headline: La ‘ley de nietos’ ni fue recurrida ni la Junta Electoral la cuestiona

articles.body: <p>La semana que ahora acaba tenía señalada una fecha importante en el calendario del <a href="https://elpais.com/noticias/plus-ultra/" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/noticias/plus-ultra/"><i>caso Plus Ultra</i></a>, en el que está investigado José Luis Rodríguez Zapatero por, supuestamente, liderar una red de influencias ilícitas que, entre otras operaciones, favoreció el rescate público en 2021 de la aerolínea que da nombre a la causa. El juez José Luis Calama había citado para el martes como investigado a Julio Martínez Martínez, amigo del expresidente del Gobierno y administrador de <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-05-19/analisis-relevante-la-empresa-clave-en-el-caso-plus-ultra-que-implica-a-zapatero.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-05-19/analisis-relevante-la-empresa-clave-en-el-caso-plus-ultra-que-implica-a-zapatero.html">Análisis Relevante, la empresa en el epicentro de la trama</a>. La cita se presumía determinante ante la duda de si el empresario respaldaría la versión de Zapatero, <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-06-17/zapatero-declara-ante-el-juez-para-defender-su-inocencia-en-medio-de-una-gran-presion-politica-para-el-gobierno.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-06-17/zapatero-declara-ante-el-juez-para-defender-su-inocencia-en-medio-de-una-gran-presion-politica-para-el-gobierno.html">que declaró en junio y aseguró que era ajeno a la creación y administración</a> de esa sociedad y solo trabajó y cobró de ella como consultor externo, o si, por el contrario, desmentiría ese relato y corroboraría el de los investigadores, que sitúan al expresidente a los mandos del entramado. Martínez Martínez no esperó a estar ante el juez y, en la víspera de su citación, <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-07-20/el-empresario-julio-martinez-senala-a-zapatero-en-el-rescate-de-plus-ultra.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-07-20/el-empresario-julio-martinez-senala-a-zapatero-en-el-rescate-de-plus-ultra.html">entregó en la Audiencia Nacional un documento</a> en el que se ofrecía a colaborar con la justicia y señalaba a Zapatero. Comenzó así un movimiento en cadena a<a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-07-22/dos-directivos-de-plus-ultra-ratifican-la-veracidad-de-mensajes-incriminatorios-que-zapatero-intenta-anular.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-07-22/dos-directivos-de-plus-ultra-ratifican-la-veracidad-de-mensajes-incriminatorios-que-zapatero-intenta-anular.html">l que se sumaron Julio Martínez Sola y Roberto Roselli</a>, también imputados y hasta entonces máximos directivos de la aerolínea Plus Ultra (dimitieron este viernes tras ser citados por el juez), que endosa al exlíder socialista la máxima responsabilidad en los hechos que se investigan.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-07-26/la-semana-que-dejo-a-zapatero-aislado-en-la-red-de-plus-ultra.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: <p>Pedro Sánchez estaba noqueado hace un año. El presidente llegó “hundido” al mes de agosto, recuerda uno de sus principales apoyos orgánicos e institucionales. Pesimismo puro. No teníamos nada claro cuánto iba a durar la legislatura. Ahora ya nadie duda de que lo hará hasta 2027″, asiente un miembro del Ejecutivo. articles.body: Les obres de l’avinguda Meridiana continuen aquest estiu amb la pavimentació dels carrils de circulació, tot aprofitant la reducció de trànsit per la via durant el mes d’agost. Així, la renovació de la calçada es farà en dues fases: de l’1 al 7 d’agost s’actuarà als carrils en sentit entrada de la ciutat, mentre que del 8 al 14 d’agost s’intervindrà als carrils en sentit sortida . Mentre duri la pavimentació, es garantirà almenys un carril de circulació obert per facilitar el trànsit dels vehicles. També et pot interessar Comencen les obres de la Meridiana i entren en servei les parades provisionals de bus interurbà Ester Magdaleno 3 minuts de lectura Entre Felip II i Fabra i Puig La pavimentació afecta el tram de la Meridiana entre el carrer de Felip II i el passeig de Fabra i Puig , que es troba en obres de remodelació integral des de la primavera del 2025. Els treballs començaran l’1 d’agost a l’altura del passeig de Fabra i Puig en sentit entrada i avançaran en direcció al carrer de Felip II. En aquest sentit, està previst que la nit del 31 de juliol es retirin els elements de protecció distribuïts actualment en calçada. A partir del 8 d’agost, els treballs es traslladaran a la calçada en sentit sortida de la ciutat. Els treballs s’iniciaran a l’altura del carrer de Felip II i avançaran en direcció al passeig de Fabra i Puig. Com en el cas anterior, la nit del 7 d’agost es retiraran els elements de l’obra existents en aquest costat de la via. També et pot interessar La FAVB planteja un bus exprés i una línia de metro per recórrer tota la Meridiana Gabriela Grífol Porta 3 minuts de lectura Canvis en la parada dels busos interurbans Pel que fa a les afectacions en la mobilitat , els treballs afectaran especialment els busos interurbans que tenen parada a l’avinguda. D’aquesta manera, les línies afectades efectuaran la parada final a Fabra i Puig , mentre que per la Meridiana els busos només hi circularan de pas. Obres a bon ritme Segons explica l’Ajuntament, les obres de la Meridiana segueixen el calendari previst amb la intenció d’acabar-les a la tardor. Durant aquesta setmana, s’està aprofitant per pavimentar les cruïlles de l’avinguda amb els carrers de Concepción Arenal, de Riera d’Horta, de Dublín i de Felip II. articles.body: Continua el retorn dels afectats per l’esvoranc de l’L9 del Putxet . Segons va anunciar el govern català divendres, aquesta setmana podran tornar a casa els veïns i negocis d’un tercer bloc, el número 6 del carrer de Rubinstein . A hores d’ara, els afectats continuen desallotjats i sense una data de retorn en el calendari. Segons els Bombers, el més probable és que els afectats hagin d’ esperar un dies més , ja que s’estan fent les últimes revisions de la finca. També et pot interessar Els veïns d’un altre dels blocs afectats per l’esvoranc de l’L9 podran tornar la setmana que ve Maria Solans 1 minut de lectura En aquest edifici viuen un total d’11 famílies . Alguns dels veïns han accedit aquest dilluns al matí a l’interior dels pisos a recollir algunes de les seves pertinences, en espera de saber quan recuperaran la normalitat. Un dels afectats assegura estar fart d’aquesta situació . “Ja tinc ganes de tornar a casa”, ha confessat. A banda dels habitatges residencials, també hi ha quatre negocis i tots continuen tancats . Segons fonts del Departament de Territori , aniran informant, cas per cas, de quan podran tornar a casa els afectats, que esperen tenir una data concreta . També et pot interessar Viure en un hotel amb 86 anys, després de l’esvoranc de l’L9: “Ens fa falta estar a casa” Lola Santiago 2 minuts de lectura La setmana vinent tornarà un altre edifici A banda, la setmana vinent —la primera d’agost— també tornaran a casa els veïns i comerciants situats al número 54 del carrer de Sant Gervasi de Cassoles , tot i que, de nou, no s’ha fixat cap dia concret. Aquests dos edificis se sumen al parell de finques que ja van tornar a casa la setmana passada , els números 56 i 58 de Sant Gervasi de Cassoles . D’aquesta manera, hauran tornat a casa el 60 % dels afectats i quedarà pendent el retorn de l’altre 40 %, que continuen desallotjats. I què passa amb la resta d’afectats? A hores d’ara, encara no se sap quan tornaran els veïns de les altres quatre finques restants: els números 2 i 4 del carrer de Rubinstein i els números 3 i 5 de Teodora Lamadrid , els més propers a la zona zero de l’esvoranc . Segons la Generalitat , ho podran fer un cop comprovin que els edificis són completament segurs . Això vol dir “assegurar que no hi ha hagut cap moviment i s’han fet les injeccions de formigó finca per finca”. Ho ha dit la consellera de Territori, Sílvia Paneque, en una entrevista a 3Cat. articles.body: La banda sonora de la Mercè 2026 arriba repartida a través del Música Mercè , el BAM i el BAM – Acció Cultura Viva . Durant cinc dies s’han programat 109 concerts en 16 escenaris en un cartell paritari que inclou 11 presentacions de disc i cinc produccions pròpies del Música Mercè. També et pot interessar Concerts de la Mercè 2026: Cartell complet per dies, hores i escenaris Núria Dias 4 minuts de lectura El Música Mercè acull 34 concerts El Música Mercè, firmat per la directora artística Gisela Sais , farà dialogar tradició i contemporaneïtat, patrimoni i experimentació amb 34 propostes gratuïtes. L’avinguda de la Catedral tornarà a ser la columna vertebral del programa amb la rumba catalana de Sabor de Gràcia , el flamenc de María Terremoto , la psicodèlia d’ Arp Frique , el rock llatinoamericà d’ Aterciopelados , la veu singular de Maika Makovski i el projecte La Barcelona Flamenca , de Luis Troquel i Chicuelo, entre d’altres. El Teatre Grec acollirà la cançó d’autor de Luísa Sobral i Nacho Vegas , que presentaran àlbum, i també el concert únic que Pol Batlle ha creat per a la Mercè 2026, així com l’ afropop de Def Mama Def . En diferents punts de la ciutat es desplegarà el pop festiu de La Pegatina i Sexenni , la ironia de Svetlana , les noves mirades de La Paloma, Marc Vilajuana i Sorvina , el folk experimental i jazz d’avantguarda de Fuensanta i el pop-folk lluminós de la mallorquina Maria Jaume . També et pot interessar La Mercè 2026 a Barcelona: Programa en PDF, concerts, Piromusical i portes obertes de la festa major Neus Valls Núria Dias 8 minuts de lectura Shanghai, la ciutat convidada La capital xinesa arribarà a Barcelona amb tres propostes que mostren la vitalitat i la diversitat de la seva escena musical: el Shanghai Conservatory of Music Jazz Ensemble , que reinterpreta el llenguatge del jazz des d’una de les institucions musicals més prestigioses del país; el Shanghai Restoration Project , que combina electrònica, hip-hop, dansa i músiques tradicionals xineses; i la Shanghai Chinese Orchestra , una de les grans formacions dedicades al patrimoni musical xinès. També et pot interessar Cinta Vidal dissenya el cartell de la Mercè 2026: “És un estampat d’edificis reconeixibles” Manel Carrasco 2 minuts de lectura El BAM, l’escena més inquieta i dissident Marta Mei i Aina Pociello han agafat les regnes del BAM – Barcelona Acció Musical . Les noves comissàries han programat 39 concerts que convertiran Barcelona en un punt de trobada de les músiques més estimulants del present. Del hip-hop amb bases electròniques d’ Uzi Freyja al rock de The Slates ; de la cançó de Sandra Monfort a les estrenes de Brama, Kiw & Mourad Belouadi i Sandré , passant pels primers concerts a Barcelona de La 126, La Valentina, Islandman, I Am Roze, Imarhan i Daoud . Tampoc hi faltaran artistes com Gala i Ovidio i Minibús Intergalàctic . La programació recorre el postpunk, l’electrònica, el folk contemporani, les músiques d’arrel, el clubbing , el rock experimental i les noves escenes urbanes per consolidar el BAM com l’espai on descobrir les veus que definiran el panorama musical dels pròxims anys. Cinc espectacles creats per a la Mercè El talent local i la recerca artística col·lectiva es concreten enguany en cinc produccions creades específicament per al festival: La Barcelona Flamenca , el diàleg musical entre Ana Rossi i Joana Queiroz , el concert simfònic de Vozes amb Marco Mezquida a Nou Barris, la proposta de Carola Ortiz a la plaça de Sant Jaume i l’estrena de Poder de protesta , la nova performance flamenca de Marco de Ana . El BAM – Acció Cultura Viva celebra la 10a edició El festival persisteix en la seva particular selecció de projectes musicals emergents de Barcelona i de Catalunya, escollits a través d’una convocatòria pública i d’un procés de programació col·lectiva. Hi actuaran artistes com Peperina, Grup de Ties, Lecocq, María Cielos, Jester i Revolución Guapachosa . Per celebrar la desena edició, el programa el tancarà l’espectacle especial La llorería , un ritual col·lectiu de boleros, ranxeres, cúmbies i merengues amb artistes vinculats al festival.

articles.body: El cinema és un entreteniment, una forma d’art, una via d’escapada i, a l’estiu, un bon refugi contra la calor. Si sou dels que us toca passar el que queda de juliol i l’agost a Barcelona, us proposem una desena d’estrenes comercials per a tots els gustos i públics que us permetran gaudir d’una estona de cultura… i de fresca. També et pot interessar Un pla perfecte 1 minut de lectura Spider-Man: Brand New Day Director: Destin Cretton Estrena: 29 de juliol No hi ha estiu sense blockbusters i, darrerament, no n’hi ha cap sense un títol de superherois. En aquesta ocasió, torna un dels més populars, “l’amic i veí Spider-Man”, després que la darrera entrega de la saga deixés en suspens el futur del personatge. Tom Holland, Zendaya i Jacob Batalon tornen a la franquícia, que compta amb la incorporació de Sadie Sink, Mark Ruffalo i Jon Bernthal, a més de Destin Cretton, que substitueix Jon Watts a la direcció. Tots plegats, intentaran reflotar un gènere de superherois que viu hores molt baixes. Mother Mary Director: David Lowery Estrena : 31 de juliol La Mary és una diva del pop que es retroba amb la Sam, una antiga amiga i amant, dissenyadora de moda, a qui encarrega la roba del seu nou espectacle. La trobada desperta traumes del passat que, mica en mica, agafen formes cada cop més fantasmals. El cineasta David Lowery, autor de A Ghost Story (2017) o El caballero verde (2021) desperta tantes adhesions com antipaties i amb el seu nou treball no posarà d’acord els dos bàndols. Mother Mary és un exercici visual i sonor no apte per a tothom, capitanejat per Anne Hathaway i Michaela Coel i amb cançons de Charli XCX, Jack Antonoff o FKA Twigs. El amor que permanece Director: Hlynur Pálmason Estrena: 7 d’agost Al llarg d’un any, el Magnus es retroba amb la seva exdona Anna a l’aldea rural on aquesta viu amb els seus fills comuns. A mesura que les estacions passen, la seva relació es va degradant en un seguit de moments quotidians que intenten mantenir, com sigui, els fonaments d’allò que un dia els va convertir en una família. Hlynur Pálmason és un dels directors islandesos més aplaudits del present i un nom habitual al D’A, en què va presentar el díptic format per El amor que permanece i Juana de Arco (2025). El final de Oak Street Director: David Robert Mitchell Estrena: 14 d’agost Alguna cosa ha passat. Sigui el que sigui, ha arrencat el carrer Oak del seu lloc original i l’ha traslladat a un entorn desconegut. En aquesta estranya situació, la família Platt aprèn ràpidament una lliçó: si volen sobreviure, han d’estar units. Ewan McGregor i Anne Hathaway (que, amb La Odisea i Mother Mary , té tres pel·lícules en cartellera aquest estiu) protagonitzen el nou treball de David Robert Mitchell, un dels noms més estimulants del cinema estatunidenc dels darrers anys, autor de la inquietant It Follows (2014) i l’ambiciosa Lo que esconde Silver Lake (2018). Cuenta atrás Director: David Mackenzie Estrena: 14 d’agost Unes obres de construcció troben una bomba de la Segona Guerra Mundial enterrada al centre de Londres. Les alarmes es disparen mentre els operaris decideixen què poden fer per evitar que exploti i acabi amb milers de vides. Mentrestant, un grup de lladres aprofita el caos del moment per fer un cop. Thriller de robatoris amb un repartiment encapçalat per Aaron Taylor-Johnson que promet escenes d’acció i dosis d’adrenalina. Insidious: fuera del más allá Director: Jacob Chase Estrena: 21 d’agost Una família d’un veïnat tranquil veu com tres intrusos volen irrompre a casa seva. Però els tres estranys no són humans, sinó figures monstruoses que venen del més enllà. Si volen enfrontar-se a ells, hauran de creuar els límits que comuniquen els dos mons. La productora Blumhouse continua esprement la gallina dels ous d’or que va ser, fa temps, la saga Insidious , tot i que del film original només queda l’actriu Lin Shaye. Ja van sis entregues, però no es pot descartar que la franquícia ens pugui arrencar encara algun ensurt… Erupcja Director: Pete Ohs Estrena: 26 d’agost La Bethany i el seu futur promès, el Rob, estan passant unes vacances romàntiques quan l’erupció d’un volcà ho trastoca tot. Atrapats a Varsòvia, sense poder tornar al seu país, la Bethany interpreta l’esdeveniment com un missatge del destí i decideix abandonar-ho tot i retrobar-se amb la Nell, una amiga d’infantesa. Charli XCX, a més de fer cançons per Mother Mary , també està present als cinemes aquest estiu com a actriu en aquest drama sentimental. Tadeo Jones y la lámpara maravillosa Director: Enrique Gato Estrena: 26 d’agost Torna Tadeo Jones, l’aventurer més exitós de l’animació espanyola. En aquest cas, el quart llargmetratge de la franquícia ens portarà del Perú a l’Orient Mitjà, perseguint una llàntia meravellosa que pot canviar el transcurs dels esdeveniments. Les aventures de Tadeo Jones són un dels cims de l’animació espanyola contemporània, per la seva popularitat i factura tècnica i artística. El ser querido Director: Rodrigo Sorogoyen Estrena: 26 d’agost Rodrigo Sorogoyen és un dels noms més consagrats del cinema espanyol recent i cada una de les seves pel·lícules, coescrites amb Isabel Peña, se segueix amb interès. En el seu nou treball, compta amb Javier Bardem i amb Victòria Luengo per carregar cada escena de talent interpretatiu i donar cos a la (mala) relació entre un pare cineasta i una filla actriu. Anoche conquisté Tebas Director: Gabriel Azorín Estrena: 26 d’agost L’António i el Jota tornen de la guerra, acompanyats d’uns amics, i se’n van a visitar unes antigues termes romanes. El que sembla un escenari bucòlic va agafant una pàtina sobrenatural quan les aigües de les termes comencen a influir en els ànims dels joves, que comencen a explicar tot allò que mai s’han atrevit a compartir amb ningú. Una de les propostes més ben valorades del darrer D’A , el primer llargmetratge de ficció de Gabriel Azorín agradarà als amants del cinema espanyol que s’atreveix a transitar els marges. articles.body: Un incendi a la catenària de l’L1 de metro ha obligat a tancar l’estació del Clot i desallotjar la de Glòries . Alguns usuaris han alertat d’una gran fumarada a les vies entre les dues estacions i, segons fonts de TMB, s’ha hagut d’evacuar el comboi que passava pel punt afectat. Els usuaris han desallotjat l’espai per les dues boques del metro. Els Bombers de Barcelona hi han traslladat 22 dotacions i han activat el Pla d’Emergències. Poc després de les vuit del vespre, el foc ha quedat extingit i ara la situació és de control . Sebastià Massagué, cap del cos de Bombers, ha comparegut per explicar que “s’ha ventilat tota la zona” i que no s’ha detectat “cap persona més a l’interior”. Ara es treballa en l ‘extracció del vagó afectat. El SEM ha atès unes 115 persones , cap en estat greu, degut a l’incident. Vint persones han estat traslladades a hospitals o Centres d’Atenció Primària. Foto cedida per l’usuari: @apteryx_7274 La incidència ha obligat a tallar l’L1, que només funciona entre Hospital de Bellvitge i Florida, entre Plaça de Sants i Universitat i entre la Sagrera i el Fondo, però que ha quedat sense servei entre Florida i Plaça de Sants i entre Universitat i la Sagrera. D’altra banda, els combois de l’L2 no s’aturen al Clot. L’incendi també ha afectat les línies H12, V25, 62 i 192 de bus, que han quedat sense circulació a l’avinguda Meridiana. La línia no funcionarà fins dimarts al matí Massagué ha explicat que la prioritat ha estat evacuar els usuaris, però que ara ja s’estan esbrinant les causes del foc . De fet, segons Xavier Flores, Conseller Delegat de TMB, podria haver estat provocat per la caiguda d’un revestiment que hi havia al túnel. Ara bé, els tècnics encara hi treballen. Per tot plegat, el més segur és que la línia no funcioni en la seva totalitat fins a dimarts a primera hora del matí : “Avui és molt just”. Alerta #FERROCAT per incendi a la catenària de la línia 1 del metro de Barcelona, entre Clot i Glòries. S'està desallotjant l'estació de Glòries i l'estació del Clot ha quedat tancada. Seguiu les indicacions de @TMBinfo i dels serveis d'emergència. pic.twitter.com/zlYvp2F2Xu — Protecció civil (@emergenciescat) July 27, 2026 “La gent no podia respirar” Segons alguns testimonis que estaven presents a l’estació de Glòries, no s’ha proporcionat ajuda immediata i per això han marxat “desesperats” de l’estació. És una versió semblant a la dels usuaris que es trobaven al Clot, que han avisat que “ la gent no podia respirar “. “Ha començat a sortir molt de fum, no sé com he estat calmada”, ha explicat una altra dona a betevé. Altres usuaris asseguren haver tingut por quan “ha començar a fer olor de cremat”. A més, la imatge que ha deixat l’incident ha estat la de desenes de persones esteses a l’exterior de les estacions intervingudes amb màscares d’oxigen . articles.body: La  previsió  del temps  per a aquest dimarts, 28 de juliol, indica un temps molt monòton. El sol s’imposarà de manera clara i la temperatura pujarà decididament. Serà el primer dia d’ascens abans d’ una calorada contundent que podria esdevenir onada de calor . Previsió horària per a Barcelona : 6 h: matinada prou agradable 9 h: algun núvol baix 12 h: ràpid ascens de la temperatura 15 h: més de 30 ºC generalitzats 18 h: tarda plenament estiuenca 21 h: nit tòrrida També et pot interessar La història interminable: una altra onada de calor truca a la porta de Catalunya Marcos Amores Sánchez 3 minuts de lectura Tornen els 30 ºC a la costa i els 35 ºC al prelitoral La previsió del temps indica molta tranquil·litat. Dimarts de sol contundent , només amb alguns estrats de núvols baixos passatgers durant les primeres hores del dia, més probables al Baix Llobregat i el Garraf. La resta del dia tindrem sol a gairebé tot arreu i temperatures que pujaran de manera decidida , especialment al prelitoral, on alguna raconada pot acostar-se o tocar ja els 35 ºC. A la costa l’ascens serà menys pronunciat però ja serà més fàcil tocar i superar els 30 ºC i, en el cas de Barcelona , fins i tot trobar algun registre que toqui els 32 ºC als barris de muntanya. La calor i la xafogor s’intensificaran, tant de dia com de nit. Ara mateix els mapes anuncien temperatures cada dia més altes fins, com a mínim el cap de setmana , quan podran tocar sostre i estabilitzar-se. Caldrà agafar-s’ho amb calma perquè els models aposten per una probable onada de calor que no només serà molt extensa i intensa sinó que podria dilatar-se bona part de la setmana vinent. Ara per ara no hi ha cap indici que faci pensar ni en una refrescada i ni tan sols en un retorn transitori a una teòrica normalitat cada cop més difícil d’aconseguir. Paciència . articles.body: Després de dies d’incògnita, encara no es coneixen les causes de l’ error detectat a les proves PISA 2025 . Ara bé, la consellera d’Educació, Esther Niubó , ha comparegut aquest dilluns i ha explicat una de les hipòtesi que hi ha sobre la taula: l’error es podria deure a una confusió de criteris amb les proves de final d’etapa de 4t d’ESO, que es van dur a terme de manera simultània a les PISA. De fet, Niubó ha apuntat que el percentatge d’exempció d’alumnat, el 23,2 %, s’assembla al percentatge d’alumnes que no va participar a les proves de 4t d’ESO el mateix curs: “Els centres van haver d’aplicar dues avaluacions sotmeses a marcs diferents”, i això fa pensar que es “creés confusió sobre els criteris que s’havien de fer servir” . Aquesta és una suposició que ja havia apuntat el secretari de Millora Educativa del Departament d’Educació, Ignasi Giménez . També et pot interessar Illa creu que no s’ha de “penjar la llufa a ningú” per l’error de PISA, sinó aclarir els fets Redacció 1 minut de lectura Ara bé, Niubó ha reiterat que aquesta és només una hipòtesi i que les diligències per descobrir què va passar, que es van obrir al març, continuen en marxa : “No anticiparem conclusions, no especularem amb les causes” . Així, ha conclòs que, quan se’n coneguin més detalls, s’explicaran amb transparència, i ha garantit que si s’acrediten responsabilitats, “es depuraran a fons”. A més, també ha aclarit que la investigació ha permès revisar l’aplicació de les proves i que s’ha detectat una mancança en els protocols que defineixen les responsabilitats, els controls i els circuits de validació de les exempcions. “Aquest incident no desacredita” Tot i assumir responsabilitat de la incidència, la consellera ha assegurat que no desacredita el sistema educatiu : “Aquest error metodològic no frenarà el compromís de millorar-lo”. A més, ha reiterat que s’està treballant per impedir que es repeteixi, perquè “ja no es pot revertir”, però que cal incidir en prevenir que torni a passar. També et pot interessar Un error impedirà comparar les proves PISA de Catalunya amb les d’altres anys i territoris Redacció 2 minuts de lectura La taxa d’exclusió impedeix comparar les dades L’origen de la incidència és la taxa d’alumnes que han quedat exclosos de les proves. Mentre que l’ Organització per a la Cooperació i el Desenvolupament Econòmic (OCDE) la fixa en un 5 %, en aquest cas s’ha situat en un 23,2 % , molt per sobre del límit . Aquesta diferència fa que els resultats de Catalunya no siguin comparables ni amb els d’altres comunitats autònomes ni amb els d’altres anys —no s’inclouran en l’informe internacional— tot i que sí que es faran per a l’informe estatal d’Espanya. Tot i que l’error es detectés al març, la notícia no es va conèixer fins fa poques setmanes. En total, 591 alumnes van quedar exempts de fer les proves: sis ho van ser per discapacitat física, 493 per discapacitat cognitiva, conductual o emocional i 92 per un domini insuficient de la llengua. articles.body: (ACN) Mango ha facturat 1.852 milions d’euros a tot el món entre els mesos de gener i juny del 2026, un 7,2 % més que durant el primer semestre de l’any passat, que és equivalent a una pujada del 10,7 % a tipus de canvi constant. En un comunicat aquest dilluns, l’empresa catalana detalla que ha invertit uns 90 milions d’euros el primer semestre per ampliar i millorar el parc de botigues, enfortir operacions i capacitats tecnològiques i expandir el Campus Mango . El negoci internacional ha suposat un 77 % dels ingressos totals de la companyia i el negoci en línia ha tingut un pes del 32 % sobre la facturació per mantenir-se com a “una de les principals palanques de creixement”. També et pot interessar Mango factura 1.852 milions d’euros en els primers sis mesos de l’any Redacció 1 minut de lectura Espanya, França i Turquia, principals mercats de Mango L’empresa va tancar el mes de juny amb una xarxa de més de 2.960 punts de venda en més de 120 països, amb 127 obertures i 37 reformes durant el primer semestre de l’any. Per volum de negoci, els principals mercats de Mango són l’Estat espanyol, França, Turquia, Alemanya i els Estats Units. Per a la companyia, els resultats “evidencien la fortalesa de la seva proposta de valor i reafirmen la trajectòria de creixement sostingut que la companyia ha mantingut els darrers anys, per sobre de la mitjana del mercat, gràcies al bon comportament del negoci i la acollida positiva de les seves col·leccions en totes les línies”.

articles.body: Aquest dilluns ha estat el primer dia laborable amb la circulació de trens restablerta entre Montcada i Reixac i Sant Andreu, després que s’hagi tapat l’esvoranc a Vallbona que va causar l’aturada del servei durant quatre dies. El tall, que afectava les línies de l’ R2, l’R2 Nord i l’R11 es va aixecar diumenge, però amb una limitació de velocitat quan els combois s’apropen al punt en què es va esfondrar la terra. Malgrat la represa del servei, entre els usuaris hi ha hagut opinions de tot tipus; des dels que es mostren satisfets perquè deixen enrere uns transbordaments obligats durant quatre dies, fins als que s’han indignat perquè han topat amb algun entrebanc inesperat i rebutgen parlar de normalitat: “Quan no és una cosa és l’altra, mai es pot parlar de normalitat “, assegura un viatger. “És molt frustrant. La gent està arribant tard a les seves obligacions i n’estem farts “, diu un altre usuari resignat. També et pot interessar Restablert el servei de l’R2, R2 Nord i R11 després de 4 dies aturades per l’esvoranc a Vallbona Eva Vial Pablo Mena 1 minut de lectura Coincidint amb la represa del servei, una de les passatgeres explica que un tren ha estat aturat més de 30 minuts a l’estació de Sant Andreu sense rebre cap mena d’informació. Una altra usuària afectada ho corrobora: “Si la normalitat és faltar al respecte a l’usuari i no donar una atenció de qualitat ; doncs sí, aquesta és la normalitat, però no la que l’usuari espera”, apunta. Optimisme i alegria per deixar els transbordaments “Després d’uns dies caòtics, avui és el primer dia que l’agafo i funciona correctament “, admet una usuària que lamenta l’estat del servei dels darrers dies. Una altra usuària corrobora la seva sensació: “ Avui bé , perquè a l’hora que marca la pantalla és a la que passa el tren”. Amb la represa del servei, es recupera la circulació de trens  entre les estacions de Sant Andreu Comtal i Montcada i Reixac , i tant les línies de Rodalies com les de mitjana distància  recuperen les freqüències  de pas habituals. articles.body: Quan pensem en nissagues polítiques a l’ Ajuntament de Barcelona , molt probablement el primer cognom que ve al cap és Maragall. Pasqual Maragall (PSC) va ostentar l’alcaldia del 1982 al 1997 i, anys més tard, el seu germà Ernest Maragall va estar a punt de convertir-se també en alcalde, a les eleccions municipals del 2019 , amb ERC. Ara bé, la família Maragall no és l’única que ha tocat poder a l’Ajuntament de Barcelona per més d’un membre. Ara mateix hi ha un regidor del govern de Jaume Collboni que va tenir un avi alcalde de la ciutat. Retrat de l’alcalde Albert Bastardas i Sampere, fet per Ramon Casas i conservat al MNAC Avi per part de mare Parlem d’ Albert Bastardas i Sampere , que va ser al capdavant de l’Ajuntament com a alcalde interí entre el 1907 i el 1909, pel Partit Republicà Autonomista. Ell era l’avi del regidor actual de Ciutat Vella i tinent d’alcaldia de Seguretat, Albert Batlle i Bastardas . Segons ha explicat el mateix Albert Batlle a betevé , Albert Bastardas era l’avi per la part de família materna: “Ell era el pare de la meva mare, que era la petita de set germans… i jo no el vaig conèixer “, recorda el tinent d’alcaldia. El regidor de Ciutat Vella i tinent d’alcaldia de Seguretat, Albert Batlle Primer alcalde popular Pel que fa al perfil polític de l’exalcalde, el llibre L’Ajuntament de Barcelona a primers de segle (1904-1909) explica que Albert Bastardas va ser “ el primer alcalde popular ” de Barcelona i va arribar a l’alcaldia després d’un vot de censura a Domènec J. Sanllehy i Alrich (de qui Bastardas era primer tinent d’alcaldia). “Bastardas tingué davant de la ciutat de Barcelona l’autoritat moral i política d’un alcalde democràtic , constitucional malgrat la inhibició legal del Govern, i republicà “, sentencia l’autor del llibre, Alfred Pérez-Bastardas. És l’ avinguda d’Albert Bastardas , al barri de les Corts , que transcorre per davant de la seu del RACC i de l’ Hotel Torre Melina Gran Meliá , i que connecta l’avinguda Diagonal amb la carretera de Collblanc (ja a l’Hospitalet de Llobregat). articles.body: El Piromusical de la Mercè 2026 a Barcelona és una de les grans propostes de la festa major. Es tracta del gran espectacle de llum, pólvora i música que conclouen les festes de la ciutat. Aquest any, els focs artificials de cloenda de la festa major canvien d’ubicació i es faran a la platja del Bogatell i no a l’avinguda de la Reina Maria Cristina com sempre, a causa de les obres. A més, novament un grup català molt conegut serà encarregat d’escollir el fil musical com van fer els Estopa l’any passat. Durant els dies previs al Piromusical, també hi haurà focs artificials a la platja en el marc del Festival Pirotècnic Internacional . A continuació et detallem tot el que has de saber del Piromusical de la Mercè 2026 , amb el dia i l’ hora del gran espectacle. La cita serà a les 22 h i a partir d’aleshores, començarà el gran espectacle de focs artificials, enguany en un escenari diferent, a la platja del Bogatell, que acollirà els milers de visitants que cada any s’aplegaven a l’avinguda Maria Cristina per gaudir de l’última proposta de la Festa Major de Barcelona. El Piromusical tindrà una durada d’uns 30 minuts, fins a les 22.30 h aproximadament.
